cases.question: Should I open a bookstore in Fenton Village?
cases.sql:
WITH fenton_tracts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT geoid FROM places WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%fenton%'
)
SELECT
  'bookstores_in_fenton_village' AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value,
  GROUP_CONCAT(name, ', ') AS detail,
  MIN(source_url) AS source_url
FROM businesses
WHERE osm_shop = 'books'
  AND geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM fenton_tracts)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'all_mapped_businesses_in_fenton_village' AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT category) AS detail,
  MIN(source_url) AS source_url
FROM businesses
WHERE geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM fenton_tracts)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'food_and_drink_listings_in_fenton_village (foot-traffic proxy)' AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT category) AS detail,
  MIN(source_url) AS source_url
FROM businesses
WHERE category_group = 'food and drink'
  AND geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM fenton_tracts)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'retail_trade_employed_residents_silver_spring_place' AS metric,
  employed_residents AS value,
  'margin_of_error ' || margin_of_error AS detail,
  source_url
FROM industry_employment
WHERE geography_type = 'place'
  AND geoid = '2472450'
  AND industry = 'Retail trade'

cases.question: We want to host an e-commerce panel. What should we keep in mind? Do we have data on people who work in retail around here?
cases.sql:
```sql
SELECT 'Retail employment (Silver Spring place)' AS metric,
       CAST(employed_residents AS TEXT) AS value,
       'margin of error +/- ' || margin_of_error AS note,
       acs_vintage,
       source_url
FROM industry_employment
WHERE geography_type = 'place'
  AND geoid = '2472450'
  AND industry = 'Retail trade'

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Event/meeting venues in Silver Spring tracts' AS metric,
       category AS value,
       'count=' || COUNT(*) || CASE WHEN COUNT(capacity) > 0 THEN '; capacity data present for some rows (unverified)' ELSE '; capacity unknown for all' END AS note,
       NULL AS acs_vintage,
       MIN(source_url) AS source_url
FROM community_venues
WHERE geoid IN (
  '24031701601','24031701602','24031701900','24031702000','24031702101',
  '24031702200','24031702301','24031702302','24031702401','24031702402',
  '24031702501','24031702502','24031702503','24031702602','24031702603',
  '24031702604','24031702700','24031702800','24031702900'
)
GROUP BY category

ORDER BY metric;
```

cases.question: How many people who identify as female live in Silver Spring?
cases.sql:
SELECT female_count,
       female_margin_of_error,
       'Census sex estimate (not gender identity)' AS note,
       source_url
FROM place_data
WHERE geoid = '2472450'

cases.question: How many restaurants are in Fenton Village?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS restaurant_count, MIN(source_url) AS source_url
FROM businesses
WHERE osm_amenity = 'restaurant'
  AND geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM places WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER('Fenton Village'))
